title: The Introducing a Little Cousin
youtube_title: The Introducing a Little Cousin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Yelena feels shy about introducing a little cousin by name. Instead of pretending not to care, Yelena tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
